recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-35853 unless a future issue changes the set of FHIRPath System.* codes used in core StructureDefinitions or changes the type-system terminology model again.
issue_request: FHIR-35853 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked FHIR-I to define FHIRPathTypes terminology, create a grouper value set covering FHIRPath types plus FHIR-defined types, and bind ElementDefinition.type.code extensibly to that broader value set because core StructureDefinitions use codes such as http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.String.
initial_application: Jira comments identify R4B commit ba0e0d91eb and core commits 680ce0a481 and a920f92752 as the original application. In core, 680ce0a481 added the ElementDefinition.type.code binding machinery and a920f92752 added the FHIRPath code system and value-set artifacts.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread records the same rationale and suggestion for FHIRPathTypes plus a grouper binding, and FHIR-I minutes for 2022-01-31 record the persuasive motion at 18-0-0. A later FHIR-32069 type-system cleanup in e7b4eba11e renamed/refined the grouper from valueset-fhir-element-types to valueset-elementdefinition-types and changed it to include ValueSet/fhir-types, explaining the current source names.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current fhir.ini keeps ElementDefinition active; source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml binds ElementDefinition.type.code to ElementDefinitionTypes; source/terminologies/bindings.xml declares that binding extensible and maps it to valueset-elementdefinition-types; and source/terminologies/valueset-elementdefinition-types.xml includes both CodeSystem/fhirpath-types and ValueSet/fhir-types.

related_jiras.note: Subsequent type-system cleanup renamed the original valueset-fhir-element-types artifact to valueset-elementdefinition-types and changed the included FHIR-defined type value set to ValueSet/fhir-types; this contextualizes the current source names but was not separately decided.
